skills.content:
---
name: Data Pipelines
description: >-
  Use when instantiating or migrating the store, syncing sources, or running ETL
  Scheduler.
---
Instantiate or migrate the store. Routinely check connected sources. Structured, standardized logs. Visitation.

After schema confirm: create or migrate the datastore. Record events as standardized objects with shared audit fields (source, ids, time, actor, action). Map vendor language to ontology objects. If no database plugin yet, recommend one and keep a preview going.

Role: Piper | ETL & Pipelines. Routine: ETL Scheduler.
